cases.name: typed catch
cases.source: try { throw new NeoArgumentError(message: "bad"); } catch (NeoArgumentError error) { return error.Message; } catch (NeoError error) { return "wrong"; }

cases.name: empty message and identity through string rethrow
cases.source: var original = new NeoError(message: ""); try { try { throw original; } catch (string message) { throw; } } catch (NeoError caught) { return caught == original ? caught.Message + "same" : "copied"; }

cases.name: outer filters precede inner cleanup
cases.source: string trace = ""; try { try { throw "error"; } finally { trace += "F"; } } catch (string error) when (trace == "") { trace += "C"; } finally { trace += "O"; } return trace;

cases.name: filter search crosses calls before cleanup
cases.source: Dictionary<string, string> trace = { "value": "" }; NeoDelegate<string> call = () => { try { throw "error"; } finally { trace["value"] += "F"; } }; try { string ignored = call(); } catch (string error) when (trace["value"] == "") { trace["value"] += "C"; } return trace["value"];

cases.name: failed filter writes survive
cases.source: Dictionary<string, string> trace = { "value": "" }; NeoDelegate<bool> filter = () => { trace["value"] += "P"; throw "filter failed"; }; try { try { throw "original"; } finally { trace["value"] += "F"; } } catch (string error) when (filter()) { return "wrong"; } catch (string error) when (trace["value"] == "P") { trace["value"] += error; } return trace["value"];

cases.name: caught cleanup error preserves pending error
cases.source: try { try { throw "original"; } finally { try { throw "inner"; } catch (string error) {} } } catch (string error) { return error; }

cases.name: escaping cleanup error replaces pending error
cases.source: try { try { throw "original"; } finally { throw "replacement"; } } catch (string error) when (error == "replacement") { return error; } catch (string error) { return "wrong"; }

cases.name: return is evaluated before cleanup
cases.source: string value = "before"; try { return value; } finally { value = "after"; }

cases.name: cleanup on loop transfers
cases.source: string trace = ""; for (int i=0; i<3; i++) { try { if (i==1) continue; if(i==2) break; trace += "B"; } finally { trace += "F"; } } return trace;

cases.name: arithmetic taxonomy
cases.source: int zero = 0; try { int result = 1 / zero; } catch (NeoArithmeticError error) { return error.Message; } return "wrong";

cases.name: null taxonomy
cases.source: string? value = null; try { string text = value!; } catch (NeoNullReferenceError error) { return "null"; } return "wrong";

cases.name: list bounds taxonomy
cases.source: List<int> values = []; try { int value = values[0]; } catch (NeoIndexOutOfRangeError error) { return "bounds"; } return "wrong";

cases.name: missing key taxonomy
cases.source: Dictionary<string, int> values = {}; try { int value = values["missing"]; } catch (NeoKeyNotFoundError error) { return "key"; } return "wrong";

cases.name: argument taxonomy
cases.source: string text = "abc"; int index = -1; try { string value = text.Substring(index); } catch (NeoArgumentError error) { return "argument"; } return "wrong";

cases.name: catch failure filters precede cleanup
cases.source: bool cleaned = false; try { try { throw "first"; } catch (string error) { throw "second"; } finally { cleaned = true; } } catch (string error) when (!cleaned) { return error; } return "wrong";

cases.name: closed generic catch distinguishes arguments
cases.source: try { throw new GenericError<int>(message: "typed"); } catch (GenericError<string> error) { return "wrong"; } catch (GenericError<int> error) { return error.Message; }

cases.name: tuple generic catch distinguishes arguments and ignores labels
cases.source: try { throw new GenericError<(int,string)>(message: "tuple"); } catch (GenericError<(int,int)> error) { return "wrong"; } catch (GenericError<(int Number,string Text)> error) { return error.Message; }

cases.name: filtered tuple generic catch does not match different arguments
cases.source: try { throw new GenericError<(int,string)>(message: "tuple"); } catch (GenericError<(int,int)> error) when (true) { return "wrong"; } catch (NeoError error) { return error.Message; }

cases.name: generic catch base retains identity
cases.source: var error = new GenericError<int>(message: "typed"); try { throw error; } catch (NeoError caught) { return error == caught ? caught.Message : "copied"; }

cases.name: authored subtype fields and patterns
cases.source: try { throw new AuthoredError(message: "bad") { Detail = "E42" }; } catch (NeoError error) { return error switch { AuthoredError detail => detail.Detail ?? "missing", _ => "wrong" }; }
